parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of autoreloader not tracking changes in manage.py, but it introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the autoreload logic in a way that may have unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the autoreload logic in a way that may have unintended side effects. It adds additional conditions and logic that could affect other modules or files.
